{{Quote|I have a petition from the Nezriti Organization. They wish an alliance with Black Sun.''"<br />"''I'm sure they do.|Mayth Duvel and Prince Xizor|<ref name="SOTE">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>}}
The '''Nezriti Organization''' was a criminal group that operated during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="CSWE" /> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of the [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Shadows of the Empire'' novel]] to [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]].</ref> shortly after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], the Nezriti Organization sent a petition of alliance to [[Dark Prince|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]], [[Underlord]] of the powerful [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate. To curry Xizor's favor, the Nezriti overture included a gift: a [[Tumanian pressure-ruby]],<ref name="SOTE" /> an extremely rare [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstone]] easily worth several million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="CSWE-Tumanian">{{CSWECite|III|267|Tumanian pressure-ruby}}</ref>

Black Sun servant [[Mayth Duvel]] delivered the petition in the form of a small package to Xizor within the [[Prince/Legends|prince's]] [[Xizor's Palace|private sanctum]]. Xizor nodded at the offering before casually tossing the gemstone onto his desk and instructing Duvel to inform the Nezriti that he would consider their proposal.<ref name="SOTE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Nezriti Organization was first mentioned in the [[1996]] novel [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Shadows of the Empire'']], written by [[Steve Perry]].<ref name="SOTE" />
